Applicants are eligible to participate in the Bachelor’s track of the Open Doors provided, as of the registration opening date, they are between 16 and 23 years of age; do not hold a Bachelor’s, Specialist, or Master’s degree; and hold, or are due to obtain during the academic year in which the Open Doors is held, an educational qualification that makes them eligible for admission to a higher education institution under the national legislation of the country in which they study.

Master’s track
Add Subject area

Applicants aged between 20 and 33 as of the registration opening date are eligible to participate in the Master’s track of the Open Doors, provided they do not hold a Specialist or Master’s degree and hold, or are due to obtain during the academic year in which the Open Doors is held, an educational qualification corresponding to at least a Bachelor’s degree.

Doctoral track
Add Subject area

Applicants aged between 22 and 35 as of the registration opening date are eligible to participate in the Doctoral track of the Open Doors, provided they have not completed a doctoral (PhD) degree program and hold, or are due to obtain during the academic year in which the Open Doors is held, a Specialist or Master’s degree.
